title: Carolina Collection Freestanding Euro-Style Toilet Paper Stand, 27-Inch, Solid Brass | Allied Brass
body_html:
Need a toilet paper holder but don’t have the wall space—or don’t want to drill into tile? This freestanding toilet paper stand keeps a roll close at hand and stays put where you place it.

  • Flexible placement beside the toilet — freestanding design works well when wall space is limited.
  • Faster roll changes — European-style hook makes swapping the roll quick and easy.
  • Stable everyday use — heavy base helps prevent tipping.
  • Coordinated traditional look — part of the Carolina Collection for matching Carolina pieces across classic bath accessories.
  • Enduring build — crafted from solid brass materials.

Specs & Installation

  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 8 in. x 27 in. x 6 in.
  • Shipping weight: 5.6 lbs
  • Assembly: Some assembly required
  • Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty

This freestanding toilet paper stand keeps a roll close at hand and stays put where you place it in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality.

  • Pink transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Faster roll changes — European-style hook makes swapping the roll quick and easy.
  • Stable everyday use — heavy base helps prevent tipping.
  • Coordinated traditional look — part of the Carolina Collection for matching Carolina pieces across classic bath accessories.
  • Enduring build — crafted from solid brass materials.

Specs & Installation

  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 8 in. x 27 in. x 6 in.
  • Shipping weight: 5.6 lbs
  • Assembly: Some assembly required
  • Multiple designer finish options available
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
